$comment: Logical self-hosted ClientHost deployment state; not OM account protocol state.

ClientHostReleaseState.release_root: owner-pinned release root id; changeable only by the owner, never by release metadata (ADR-0129 rule 12)
ClientHostReleaseState.deploy_delay_s: owner-configurable delay before automatic deploy (default 86400; a SecurityAdvisory from the pinned root may shorten it to no less than 3600)
ClientHostReleaseState.transparency_observations: release-transparency observations of the release digest (at least two independent monitors before automatic deploy)
ClientHostReleaseState.minimum_security_version: owner-local floor set by the ClientHost owner, informed by SecurityAdvisories (ADR-0104); never remotely set

Rule: ClientHost deployment state is replaceable infrastructure state and never identity authority.
